# 1. Overview

Data preparation, which includes data access and modeling, forms the foundation of data analysis. Typically, users need to perform data access before conducting data analysis.

Data connection is the first step in interfacing with a database. Once completed, you can create datasets as input for data analysis, or use them as input for data visualization modeling. Visualization modeling refers to basic data processing, data cleansing, and modeling operations performed on existing data. The resulting datasets can be used for data query and analysis. IT personnel, data developers, or data analysts usually perform more operations during the visualization modeling phase.

# 2. Module entry point

In the top bar of the product interface, click "Data Preparation". The dropdown menu includes: Data Connection, Visualization Modeling, and Datasets. Click any entry to access the corresponding module. As shown in the following diagram:

# 3. Module introduction


* [Overview of Data Connection](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Overview_of_Data_Connection): Creating a data connection can be understood as establishing a credential for connecting to a database and accessing data tables. By creating a data connection, you can quickly obtain table information from the database, create datasets, and then process or cleanse input tables during the visualization modeling process.

* [Dataset Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Dataset_Overview): A dataset is the foundation for storing and managing data, and also serves as the basis for visualization queries and analysis. In simple terms, it can be regarded as a type of data table. Users need to create datasets from the source tables to be analyzed before proceeding with subsequent modeling operations. In the dataset module, you can create, edit, and manage datasets.

* [Overview of Visual Modeling](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Overview_of_Visual_Modeling): Provides data processing and modeling capabilities, which are commonly referred to as ETL (Extract\-Transform\-Load), and can also be called data modeling. Visual modeling, serving as an intermediary between data sources and data analysis, enables users to perform drag\-and\-drop, easy\-to\-use, intelligent, and efficient data processing on initial datasets before analysis, so that after the data is cleaned, transformed, and loaded, the resulting dataset is better suited for business analysis. At the same time, this module also supports capabilities such as model training and algorithmic prediction.


The above is a brief introduction to the three modules. You are welcome to consult the individual documents for more information.
